From: Alex Rivas <alex@novaprod.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NovaProd — Org setup + API key plan

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — NovaProd is ready to move toward a minimal production pilot. A few asks from our side to unblock the first sprint:

- We need a clear sequence for admin invites (who needs what role) and a seeded API key for our sandbox project.
- We plan to provision an org with two projects (sandbox, staging). Can Redwood recommend project-level roles for ops/dev/product?
- Our security team wants an evidence packet (roles matrix + invitation log scope) for SOC review.

I attached a quick CSV with the tentative admin roster. Can you confirm next steps and an ETA for the seeded keys?

Best,
Alex
Head of Platform — NovaProd

Attachment: novaprod_admin_roster.csv (1.2 KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivas <alex@novaprod.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2029 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaProd — Org setup + API key plan

Hi Alex — great to see this moving so quickly. Looping in Monica (CS lead) and Ben (implementation) to own the kickoff. Quick answers inline below, and Monica will follow up with the implementation plan and a checklist PDF.

- Admin invites: we recommend 3 roles for the initial pilot — Owner (org-level, billing & SLA), Admin (project-level provisioning), Developer (token use). We'll seed one Owner and two Admins as per your CSV.
- API key seeding: Ben will generate a scoped sandbox API key (team-scoped, rate-limited) and post it to the secure ticket. Keys for staging will be generated after the workspace is live and a short smoke test passes.
- Evidence packet: we can produce a roles matrix + invite audit log export (CSV) and a one-page summary for your security team. Expect the package within 48 hours after invites are accepted.

Next step: Monica will schedule the 30-minute kick-off to confirm identities and finalize the invite cadence. Ben — can you prepare the sandbox key and a short runbook for rotating it?

Thanks,
Soojin
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Yep — I can have the sandbox key ready and a one-page runbook by EOD Friday (June 14). Plan:

1) Create sandbox project inside NovaProd org (read-only billing tie to your account).
2) Seed a scoped API key named novaprod-sandbox-2029-06 with IP restrictions (if provided) and a token TTL of 30 days for the pilot.
3) Provide a key rotation snippet (curl + Node example) and an ops checklist for rotating via the Console or CLI.

Questions for Alex: do you want the initial sandbox key tied to an Okta service account or to a generic service user? If Okta SSO service account, send the client_id and cert thumbprint and I will attach IP allow-listing.

Ben
